parsed.explanation: This is an outed-traveller exposure set. The state's executive order fixes sex at birth, endorses single-sex bathrooms/changing rooms and withdraws recognition, and there is no state-wide gender-identity public-accommodations or hate-crime provision; a 2025 poll shows a large majority backing birth-sex document rules, so the climate is hostile, not merely curious. Custody is a documented unremedied harm: a trans woman was housed with men, celled with a sex offender who assaulted her, and the court dismissed failure-to-protect and treatment claims as de minimis (2022). Against that, no facility-use enforcement provision or arrest is documented in this state, facility bans are not shown reaching visitors' private accommodation, national hate-crime law covers gender identity, and marriage/adoption are settled. The parent border regime — refusal on document discrepancy, possible lifetime fraud findings, foreign-government advisories — is a real but conditional entry exposure (severity 3). Tier-1 custody harm (conditional) plus hostile state policy and border friction, without documented street-level targeting or enforced facility exclusion, place this below the 0.45 universal-enforcement tier and above the 0.25 organised-coercion tier.
